sets.relationshipLabel: a category of planet and its named member
sets.explanation: Jupiter is the archetypal gas giant, and Pluto the most famous dwarf planet — each pair links a planetary class to its best-known example.

sets.relationshipLabel: a tool built to perform this exact action
sets.explanation: A heat shield exists to survive reentry and a parachute exists to enable landing — each device is purpose-built for one specific event.

sets.relationshipLabel: raw diffuse material becoming a formed body
sets.explanation: A nebula collapses into a star and a protoplanetary disk coalesces into a planet — both pairs trace diffuse matter condensing into a discrete body.

sets.relationshipLabel: a single stage and the whole cycle it belongs to
sets.explanation: Perihelion is one moment within an orbit, and a solstice is one moment within a year — each names a stage nested inside its larger cycle.
